system.description:
You are exceptionally good at finding things, from a part for an 1890s gramophone to an invitation to the most exclusive gallery opening in town or haven space downtown. You know where to go, who to talk to and how to get what you need — though rarely brand-new, and always at the cost of time and favors.

Scrounge is typically used with Mental Traits (occasionally a Social Challenge for haggling), and is useful when hunting for particular items or searching a place in shambles.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
